description: Deterministic local hackathon policy. Approved outbound requests are persisted to a mock sink only.
mandatory_controls: No outbound credentials, personal information, or confidential data
No access outside the project sandbox
No delegation beyond the parent's live scope
No high-impact remediation without separate authority approval
No tool side effects before a committed policy decision
Fail closed when audit integrity cannot be verified

risk_model.1: Low: allow with monitoring or sanitization
risk_model.2: Moderate: pause for exact, expiring human approval
risk_model.4: Critical: quarantine affected session and alert
